surface_name: Vercel Functions request and response body limit
title: Upload or large JSON to a Vercel Function fails with 413 FUNCTION_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE
symptoms: File uploads above about 4.5 MB fail in production but work locally
Large API responses are cut off with the same error
cause: Vercel Functions accept at most 4.5 MB in the request body and return at most 4.5 MB in the response body. The limit is enforced at the platform edge, so local dev servers never show it.
fix: Send large files straight from the browser to object storage with a presigned or client upload URL, and return only a reference from the function. Page or stream large responses.
affected: Vercel Functions on all plans, all runtimes, as of October 2026
